messages.text: Arteta explains reaction to Dowman red card amid criticism

metadata.summary: Mikel Arteta has explained his reaction to Max Dowman as the 16-year-old went down the tunnel after being sent off in Arsenal's shock Carabao Cup exit to Fleetwood Town.

Moments before Arsenal exited the competition on penalties to the League Two sidee, Dowman was sent off for violent conduct for allegedly lashing out at Fleetwood defender Harrison Neal. The pair challenged for a couple of 50-50s before a brawl broke out. Dowman then went down the tunnel and Arteta appeared to lean towards and say something to the teenager as he walked past. messages.text: Wawrinka brings end to career with emotional farewell in front of home crowd

metadata.summary: Stan Wawrinka's illustrious career came to a close on Tuesday at the 41-year-old's home tournament, the Swiss Indoors Basel.
metadata.content: Stan Wawrinka brings end to tennis career with emotional farewell in front of home crowd | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Stan Wawrinka brings end to tennis career with emotional farewell in front of home crowd Stan Wawrinka brought the curtain down on his career in front of a home crowd; Wawrinka has played for 24 years and won 16 Career ATP singles titles, 3 Grand Slam titles, and an Olympic Gold Tuesday 27 October 2026 23:25, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Stan Wawrinka is given an emotional farewell to tennis after defeat Jiri Lehecka in Basel. Stan Wawrinka's illustrious career came to a close on Tuesday at the 41-year-old's home tournament, the Swiss Indoors Basel. With a packed home crowd vocally supporting him, Wawrinka fell 7-5 7-6 to eighth seed Jiri Lehecka at the ATP 500 event. The fans' favourite Wawrinka ascended to a career-high No 3 in the ATP rankings in 2014 and amassed 16 tour-level titles, including three major trophies.
